answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. A farm faces a waiting period of 10 days that no payment can shorten for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. To join, a name must pass Marked trombone maker loom token, which works because a token makers wear after trombone inspections. Every orchard is counted once. The clerk notes nectar. One dawn, one entry.
